title: City Of Syracuse to Close Offices in Observance of Labor Day
summary: City of Syracuse will close administrative offices on Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day observance. Trash/recycling pickup will be delayed one day, Department of Public Works yard waste drop-off will be closed, and metered parking will be free. Emergency services and online Cityline requests remain available.
processing_notes: This is a routine holiday closure announcement with no budget, procurement, or policy implications for CIO purview.
SYRCityline app and syr.gov/cityline digital channels remain operational, indicating continuity of digital service delivery.
